what: On hover it squashes flat to .8 vertical scale in 10ms, then bounces with a .2s back.out to its full size (or the to scale). On release it returns to 1 scale and 0° in .2s expo.out — the same feel for knit menu cells, signs, flower ornaments and badges

options.sx · sy: Horizontal·vertical scale when pressed, default 1 · .8 — original signboard sy .9, flower·badge sx=sy .7
options.rotate: Angle rotated when pressed (°), default 0 — original flowers 10·−8·−6, badge −10
options.alt: With multiple targets, flip the angle every other one (1 turns it on)
options.to: Scale held after the pop, default 1 — original flower 1.1
options.dur · hit · out: Pop, press and release durations (s), default .2 · .01 · .2
options.target: Child role name to move (data-fx-part) — all of them if several
options.area: Child role name that measures the hand

from.where: index.html bottom knit menu cell (sy .8) · ”Dog Run” sign (sy .9) and three flowers (.7→1.1, 10·−8·−6°) · figurine badge (.7, −10°) · back-to-top arrow (sy .7)
